get_cfg: get a cloned copy of the default SlowFast configuration with all validated settings
assert_and_infer_cfg: validate and infer config settings including BN, TRAIN, TEST, RESNET assertions and LR scaling
configure_batch_norm: configure batch normalization options including norm type, weight decay, and precise stats
configure_training: configure training options including dataset, batch size, eval period, and checkpoint settings
configure_slowfast_model: configure SlowFast model options including beta inverse, alpha, fusion kernel size, and channel ratio
